Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers to the questions that come up most at the table.

Can't find your question? Each game also has a full guide: Call Break rules, Marriage rules and Teen Patti rules.

Frequently asked questions

Does TaasMaster work without internet?

Yes. After your first visit, the site is stored on your phone and works offline — handy during load-shedding or when mobile data is weak.

How do I install TaasMaster on my phone?

On Android (Chrome), tap the Install button at the top or choose 'Add to Home screen' from the menu. On iPhone (Safari), tap Share and then 'Add to Home Screen'.

Will I lose my scores if I refresh the page?

No. Scores are saved on your phone after every change, so a refresh, closed tab or restart keeps the game. Starting a New game clears it.

Are my scores uploaded anywhere?

No. Everything stays in your phone's browser storage. Nothing is sent to a server, and there is no account.

Can two phones share the same game?

Not yet — each phone keeps its own game. Pick one scorekeeper per table.

How is Call Break scored with extra tricks?

Each extra trick above your call adds 0.1. Call 3 and win 5, and you score 3.2. Winning fewer than your call loses your call.

How many points does an unseen player pay in Marriage?

In common rules, each unseen player pays the winner 10 points and each seen player pays 3. You can change these values in the calculator's options.

What happens if nobody else saw the maal in Marriage?

Then only the winner's maal counts. The winner collects their maal points from each other player, plus the unseen fee (commonly 10) from each of them.

Is the Teen Patti tracker for real money?

No. It records points only. TaasMaster has no real-money features.

Is TaasMaster free?

Yes, completely free, with no sign-up.
